turns.learner: Hello teacher. I want to practise talking about things around me, like my room.
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good topic. Let us look at a, an and the.
We use a for the first time: I have a dog.
We use the for the same dog again: The dog is brown.
Now write two short sentences about one thing in your room. Say it first, then say it again.

turns.learner: I have a bed in my room. A bed is big and very comfortable.
turns.tutor:
You have most of it. "I have a bed in my room." is good.
Now look at the start of your second sentence: "A bed is big and very comfortable."
Think about the first word. It is the same bed again. Try to write the second sentence again.

turns.learner: I think it is correct. A bed is big and very comfortable. Bed is one thing, so I use a.
turns.tutor:
You are right about one part: "Bed is one thing." And "I have a bed in my room." is good.
Look at your second sentence. Is the bed new, or the same bed? Answer with one word: new or same.

turns.learner: Same bed. But I still think a is okay, because bed is only one.
turns.tutor:
Yes, it is the same bed. A bed is one thing, that is true, but "A bed" does not fit when it is the same bed again.
Look at the first word of your second sentence. Change only that word and write the sentence again.

turns.learner: My bed is big and very comfortable? I am not sure why a is wrong.
turns.tutor:
"My bed" is a good sentence, but this practice is about a, an and the.
Look again at my dog sentences at the start. One word changed for the same dog. Use that idea: write your second sentence with a different first word than "My".

Tell me the rule in your own words.

turns.learner: Maybe the is for the second time? I think a is for one thing, the is for... I am not sure.
turns.tutor:
Your idea "the is for the second time" is right. The other part is not complete: a is not only for one thing, it is for the first time.
Say the rule again in your own words.
